dialogues.speaker: Kuzmich
dialogues.text: Oh my, I can't believe they're all sold out! Looks like I do have some business sense after all.

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmich
dialogues.text: Next, I'll ask the Lightkeepers to guide me through the Dreadshade Mire. After that, it should be a straight shot to the north.

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmich
dialogues.text: Maybe I'll find some business opportunities on my way back... Well then, this is where we part. Until we meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmich
dialogues.text: What a coincidence, we meet again! Would you like to buy something? My new stock isn't moving at all... please, help me out here.

choices.text: Let me see what good stuff you have.

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: These are all local specialties. Don't worry, I'll give you the very best price!

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: Well, you know how it is — business is business. Strike while the iron's hot, right? I came across a good opportunity in Piramida, someone needed to sell their goods urgently and gave me a good price.

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: I got a little too excited and forgot I was supposed to be heading home... so I bought everything. And now, here I am...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Guess why he's in such a hurry to sell.

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: Agh, please don't rub it in... Why not have a look instead? Maybe you'll find something useful.

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: Hey... don't leave yet! I'm sure there's something you need!

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmich
dialogues.text: Great! Finally sold everything. Looks like the old "small profit, quick turnover" strategy really works.

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmich
dialogues.text: By rights, I should be heading back to Snezhnaya... though right now I've barely made enough for the journey. I came here empty-handed, and I'd rather not go back the same way!

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmich
dialogues.text: *sigh* Anyway, thanks for supporting my business.

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmich
dialogues.text: Oh my, fate works in mysterious ways — running into you here again! Want to take a look? This time I've got some pretty good stuff.

choices.text: Let's see what good stuff you have.

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: Hey, all of this is retired equipment the Fatui got rid of. You won't find it anywhere else, so take whatever you like!

choices.text: Didn't you go back to Snezhnaya?

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: To be honest, my home is in Novokitezhgrad, and my whole family works in the mines. They are all more stubborn than the Domovoy, and when I said I wanted to go into business, they were dead set against it.

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: So before I left, I made a big promise to make a fortune... But who would've thought I'd end up barely able to scrape together enough money for the journey back.

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: Making it big is out of the question now, but at least let me earn a little — something to show for when I get back.

choices.text: Why are you in Fatui territory?

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: Oh, come on! I'm a law-abiding Snezhnayan, and being around the Fatui here feels just like being at home.

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: All my goods here are retired equipment the Fatui got rid of, and they specifically asked me to handle it. You won't find anything like this anywhere else, this is the only place.

choices.text: No thanks, I'll be going now.

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: Ah, what a pity...

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmich
dialogues.text: Thank you so much, really... thank you! Thanks to you, I won't have to go back looking so miserable!

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmich
dialogues.text: This is really goodbye. You've bought so much from me — guess that makes us friends now.

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmich
dialogues.text: If you ever get the chance to come to Snezhnaya, come find me in Novokitezhgrad. See you next time!

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmich
dialogues.text: Business really is terrible these days... Maybe I should save up some money and try to rent a stall in Nasha Town...

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: Just some trinkets I got from Natlan, feel free to take a look if anything interests you.

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: Oh my, a customer! Hello there! I'm Kuzmich, a traveling merchant from Snezhnaya.

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: Well, that's what I like to call myself, but I'm just doing a bit of small business on my travels to earn some money for the journey.

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: But when I passed through Natlan, the people there were just too enthusiastic, and I got caught up in the moment and... Now if I don't sell all this merchandise, I won't even have enough money for a ticket back home.

choices.text: Are you going back to Snezhnaya?

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: Yes, once I sell this batch of goods, I'll buy a train ticket and head back.

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: Although it snows there all year round, and everywhere is covered in ice and snow, you can only stay cooped up in the city every day...

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: But after being away for so long, I'm starting to miss the days when I could sleep all day at home.

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: Yeah... but if I want a proper stall in town, I'll have to borrow money from Northland Bank. I heard the one in Nasha Town doesn't have a very good reputation...

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: Ah, whatever. At least there's good foot traffic here. As long as people keep passing by, the goods will sell eventually, right?

choices.text: Sorry, I have to go now.

response.speaker: Kuzmich
response.text: Hey, why are you leaving already? Won't you take a look...
